description: Writer id of one attempt (agent run). A pure function of the attempt id, so a resume or a second reader derives the same id and the same envelope digest. The supervisor mints it and the controller computes the same value to publish a delegation before the attempt starts; both call the one function in fgos-session-identity (Rust) or its Node client, never a copy.

errors.invalid-attempt-id: attemptId is empty, longer than maxAttemptIdLength, or has a character outside attemptIdPattern; the function never trims, lowercases, truncates or substitutes characters

constraints.why: the minted id must pass the resolve rule's usable-id test (session-identity.resolve.v1.json: idPattern and maxIdLength 200), otherwise the agent's FGOS_SESSION_ID would be ignored and resolution would fall to the process tree

environment.FGOS_SESSION_ID: the minted writer id of the attempt (never empty)
environment.FGOS_PARENT_WRITER_ID: writer id of the controller that wrote the envelope; absent when the controller has none

vector: packages/session-identity/contracts/vectors/attempt-writer-id.v1.json; the Rust and the Node implementation must reproduce every case
